A painter named Peter Peutemann On 18-09-1692, Peter Peutemann was on a run in a film studio and saw a man dancing. When Peter saw a man dancing, he was scared and died. Peter was unaware that the bone that he brought he got in the form of a model, he was actually being shaken because of the earthquake. Number 4 King Rmendranarayan Rai of India's majestic kingdom. whose annual income was 4 hundred million dollars. He died in 1909. A grieved crowd burned his death on the pyre in front of the people. Twelve years later, the king returned in the pyre and set on fire, Twelve years later the king returned as a monk, He came face to face with this claim, When their pyre was set on fire, Then suddenly a strong rain forced everyone together to run from there, And the fire of the pyre went out because of the rain, Some Naga sages were Nagas were passing by, they saw them in their unconscious state and treated them, when they were cured, they had lost their memory and he took his Sages with him a Sanyasi when he come back with this claim, his widow wife called him a cheat and insulted him For that reason his wife denied his application as a sanyasi , She was accused of defamation For three years this case went on in the courts Finally court considered him to be sanyasi raja Raman Naraend Rai which was not in force then British Prevail Council gave back his status and rights in 1935 5. Another event similar to this Concel's had returned the right to his status back. Number 5 Another similar incident happened. In 1763, a French man named John Paul Tronque was sentenced to be divided into four in the arrest of Duke de Guise A person who was punished was so powerfull that not a single death sentence could be given They even tied his feet feet were tied three times by new horses. No. 7 On 30th April 1888, in Moradabad, India, there was a deadly shower of big round oles on the same size of a baseball on which 230 people died. It was the most brutal ola-e-wra tragic events of history. 1. 8 An 18th century french army General whose name was Baptiste de Maront Maurin was found dead five times on battleground. Yet he didn't die because of his service at all. He served the french army for 55 years, and died at 75 years old. And this is how how many times they died.
